summary: 自然语言补充信息项后生成信息协商提议消息，双语渲染均与 golden 一致，且 fromText 与 fromData 两路等值

text.zh-CN: 请补充节能区域信息（如松山湖）、节能速率保障目标（如20Mbps）与VLANId三项信息，三项之间为或的关系。
text.en-US: Please supplement the energy-saving area information (e.g. Songshan Lake), the energy-saving rate guarantee target (e.g. 20Mbps) and the VLANId; the three items are related by OR.

summary: 确认信息后从自然语言生成信息协商接受消息，消息含 Accept 结论字面量，且 fromText 与 fromData 两路等值

text.zh-CN: 我确认第一阶段的信息：节能区域为松山湖，节能速率保障目标为20Mbps。
text.en-US: I confirm the first-stage information: the energy-saving area is Songshan Lake and the rate guarantee target is 20Mbps.

summary: 信息无法提供时从自然语言生成信息协商拒绝消息，消息含 Reject 结论字面量，且 fromText 与 fromData 两路等值

text.zh-CN: 无法提供节能区域信息：站点库存数据暂不可用，本轮协商拒绝。
text.en-US: The energy-saving area information cannot be provided because the site inventory is unavailable; this round is rejected.

summary: 首轮目标协商从自然语言生成提议消息，首轮渲染意图理解与待澄清内容两个板块，且 fromText 与 fromData 两路等值

text.zh-CN: 无线节能优化任务的意图理解：对目标站点在08:00-18:00执行无线节能优化，节能期间速率保障不低于20Mbps；对区域与节能时间范围仍有疑问，请澄清和确认。
text.en-US: The intent understanding of the wireless energy-saving optimization task: apply wireless energy-saving optimization to the target site during 08:00-18:00 with a guaranteed rate of at least 20Mbps; open questions remain about the area and the time range, please clarify and confirm.

summary: 意图确认后从自然语言生成目标协商接受消息，消息携带最终确认意图并含 Accept 结论字面量，且两路等值

text.zh-CN: 最终确认的意图：对松山湖站点在08:00-18:00执行无线节能优化，节能期间速率保障不低于20Mbps。
text.en-US: The finally confirmed intent: apply wireless energy-saving optimization to the Songshan Lake site during 08:00-18:00 with a guaranteed rate of at least 20Mbps.

summary: 信息无法澄清时从自然语言生成目标协商拒绝消息，消息携带拒绝原因并含 Reject 结论字面量，且两路等值

text.zh-CN: 无法完整澄清区域信息：站点库存数据不可用，本轮目标协商拒绝。
text.en-US: The area information cannot be clarified in full because the site inventory is unavailable; this target negotiation round is rejected.

data.failure_reason: The area information cannot be clarified in full because the site inventory is unavailable.

summary: 从自然语言生成可行性协商提议消息，请求对方评估调整后的速率保障目标，且 fromText 与 fromData 两路等值

text.zh-CN: 请评估站点级节能任务调整后的速率保障目标是否可行：节能期间速率保障目标由5Mbps下调至2Mbps，且停电场景下供电时长不少于10小时。
text.en-US: Please assess whether the adjusted rate guarantee target of the site-level energy-saving task can be achieved: the rate guarantee target is lowered from 5Mbps to 2Mbps during 08:00-18:00, with at least 10 hours of power supply duration in outage scenarios.

data.feasibility_negotiation_description: Please assess whether the adjusted rate guarantee target of the site-level energy-saving task can be achieved, see <Under Evaluation Description>; please assess.

contents_to_evaluate.name: adjusted target
contents_to_evaluate.value: rate guarantee target lowered from 5Mbps to 2Mbps during 08:00-18:00

contents_to_evaluate.name: existing constraint
contents_to_evaluate.value: at least 10 hours of power supply duration in outage scenarios

summary: 评估通过后从自然语言生成可行性协商接受消息，消息携带可行性结论并含 Accept 结论字面量，且两路等值

text.zh-CN: 调整后的速率保障目标可以实现并满足停电时长要求，本次可行性协商确认达成一致。
text.en-US: The adjusted rate guarantee target is achievable and satisfies the outage duration requirement; this feasibility negotiation is confirmed as concluded.

data.feasibility_summary: The adjusted rate guarantee target is achievable and satisfies the outage duration requirement; this negotiation is confirmed as concluded.

summary: 评估不通过时从自然语言生成可行性协商拒绝消息，消息携带不可行结论并含 Reject 结论字面量，且两路等值

text.zh-CN: 在现有供电约束下节能目标无法达成，本次可行性协商确认无法达成一致。
text.en-US: The energy-saving target cannot be achieved under the existing power supply constraint; this feasibility negotiation is confirmed as concluded without agreement.

data.feasibility_summary: The energy-saving target cannot be achieved under the existing power supply constraint; this negotiation is confirmed as concluded.

text.zh-CN: 协商轮次已达上限，本次协商确认终止。
text.en-US: The negotiation round limit is reached; this negotiation is confirmed as terminated.
